question: Les exécutions taker qui réduisent la position ETH présentent-elles un mouvement de prix ultérieur différent des exécutions taker ouvrantes ?

primary_measure.midpoint: (best_bid+best_ask)/2 from BBO or top L2, with positive price and quantities

groups.opening: pre-position is zero or fill increases absolute exposure on same side
groups.reducing: fill decreases absolute exposure without changing sign or ending flat
groups.inverting: fill crosses through zero; report separately and split close/open quantities arithmetically; exclude from primary open/reduce contrast
groups.unknown: missing/invalid crossed, side or startPosition; retain separately

collection.fill_source: public REST userFillsByTime pages, explicitly not live userFills websocket
collection.quote_sources: existing shared websocket BBO and l2Book for ETH; do not add a user websocket subscription
collection.timestamps: retain exchange event time, frame receive time, REST response receipt and raw_observations archive availability
collection.depth: retain best bid/ask sizes from both BBO and top L2

secondary_measure.definition: midpoint movement in fill direction from the last quote locally received by the time our REST fill page arrives to a quote first received 60s later
secondary_measure.interpretation: delayed public-page receipt measurement, not fill receipt at venue and not our execution

decision.favorable: both taker opening and reducing groups have usable 60s outcomes and reducing median is positive and greater than opening median
decision.unfavorable: both groups have usable outcomes and reducing median is non-positive and no greater than opening median
decision.indeterminate: both groups have outcomes but favorable and unfavorable rules do not apply
decision.insufficient: either primary group has no usable 60s outcome; preserve all coverage, gaps, errors and missing reasons
decision.confidence: descriptive only; no independent-fill or statistical-confidence claim
decision.promotion: no paper promotion, regardless of result
